# Quosel

> Quosel is the fastest way to build local-business websites: start from a modern template, let AI write the copy, and share a live link clients can edit in real time — then publish to their own custom domain. Built for freelancers and agencies.

## Pages

- [Home](https://quosel.com/): Product overview, features, editor demo, pricing, and FAQ.
- [Privacy Policy](https://quosel.com/privacy/): How Quosel collects, uses, and protects personal data.
- [Terms of Service](https://quosel.com/terms/): The terms governing use of Quosel.
